title: OFM common definitions
description: Building blocks shared by all OFM payload schemas. Not a payload on its own.

ts.description: Epoch milliseconds, UTC (ADR-0003). The bounds (2020-01-01 to 2100-01-01) catch a value sent in seconds or microseconds by mistake.

quality.description: Data quality: good, uncertain (e.g. out of range, clock skew) or bad (e.g. source offline).

tss.description: Timestamp provenance (ADR-0003): device = source timestamp from the device; gateway = stamped by the runtime on arrival.

id.description: Immutable integer ID of a model entity (ADR-0004).
